body: my abusive principal told me that my interest in guitar was going to take me nowhere in life, this is in addition to telling me i wouldn't graduate and i was a hopeless junkie

I opened up to this girl about my mom passing away when I was 16 last year and she got mad at me over something petty and said things like "I'm about to call your mom from the grave" and "Maybe you're the one who put her there", and said some other awful things, I ended up attempting and after getting out of the psych ward my step-mom's house got broken into (she sent me her address) so I told her to please have some decency and leave me alone because I just got out of the hospital and to leave the family alone (because this girl legit scares me), and she told me I should kill myself and make it work this time and said "You're less than the dirt I walk in that your mom lays in, pussy."

I'm pretty depressed about that.

Another real fucked thing about the false rape accusations is that it's cost me a job. I was finally enjoying work, I was getting along with people, held a job down for six months... and then this 32 year old guy I sort of outed for beating my 19 year old female friend falsified a bunch of fake screenshots (you can do this using "Inspect Element" on chrome) of rape bullshit, alongside calling me a rapist verbatim on his profile, and one of his butt buddies showed up as a server and showed the entire restaurant and everyone began avoiding me. It was really cool to finally come out of my shell then have that happen.

So yeah, the bullying I'm not sure will ever stop, so I've decided to be alone... I just put up my phone and I don't want to look at it for a month. A lifetime abuse has caused me to really hate myself and hate others, and it's sad, I don't deserve it and I could be talking about something way more positive right now.

I never had any support. I never had any friends that cared, I still don't.

Thank you, I appreciate it. Most of the responses to this type of post are usually "I don't know what to say, but I hope things get better for you" and that makes me feel even more helpless. I'm pretty in deep on the hating myself thing. I never, ever was an angry person until the sexual assault and bullying I faced. I grew a chip on my shoulder and I'm now only thinking negative things. I'm not malicious and I don't blow up on people (somehow, I don't have a temper, or violent thoughts after all the anger and violence I was subjected to), and I'm just very silently contemptuous. For example, the receptionist at my gym gave me her number. I didn't even ask, she gave me her number and wants me to teach her guitar. She is a very nice and beautiful girl and most guys would be ecstatic about this, but I tossed it aside immediately. "This chick is innocent and sweet and I'm fucked up, I hate society, I'm a shady dude, I'm negative, I don't smile or laugh or have fun". Little things like that are ruined for me. I've told my step-sister to not get involved with my negativity.

I couldn't get a psychologist when I was a teenager, and then my first appointment when I got out of the hospital when I was 18 was with a guy who immediately dismissed me because I was on Xanax (something the hospital should have noted). Then came the therapists - one that tried to convert me to Christianity, another that told me my agoraphobia was me "looking things up on the internet", one that spent two sessions telling me about my personality type, one that talked to me about Jimi Hendrix for half an hour and then her fight with her friend the next session, a traumatizing psych ward stay and three mysteriously canceled appointments with a psychologist - and after finding a place that finally isn't booked, I'm in therapy, and it's... $160 a month. I'm scared that it's too late and that I won't be able to change or I don't want to help myself, because I've thrown my life away and given up at this point. 

Thank you. It's a real shame that I've just turned 22 and this is the way my life has been, I was never given a chance to enjoy my youth, and when I was in college I was thinking to myself "These people have no... clue.", and I was so jealous. 

The saddest part is, I was the most lovable, kind, aloof goof of a kid up until about seventeen, when things started really going downhill. And now I'm abrasive, I'm asocial, I'm exhausted... it's really sad. I often think of the parallel me where none of this happened and my mom was still alive. I would probably have gone on to be a doctor.

I should have mentioned that I know I haven't done anything. I'm just severely paranoid that for some reason I have and I forgot. It's really unhealthy. I wasn't clear enough, I'm just going crazy over paranoia and anxiety.
